roadmap.title: Story playthrough
roadmap.note: Play Chapters 1-5 (about 60-80 hours). Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia, take optional missions as they appear, and scan new vehicles and study new animals as you go.

roadmap.title: Side strands and strangers
roadmap.note: Finish the optional questlines for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret, plus 8 Strangers & Freaks strands. All of them stay available after the story.

roadmap.title: Activities and challenges
roadmap.note: Stunts, races, drone races, shooting ranges, robberies and combat feats. Most of these feed the 100% checklist too.

roadmap.title: Collectibles, exploration and money
roadmap.note: Card sets, WAiNK scans, vehicles, the full map, meditation spots, garages and the money trophies. Bank vaults are the best late-game earner.

roadmap.title: 100% checklist and cleanup
roadmap.note: After the story, open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion and finish the checklist (about 100 hours). Then mop up anything left and the platinum pops.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are yours. No multiplayer or DLC is needed: every trophy is single-player and offline. Expect a long road — guides put the full run at roughly 200 hours, most of it spent on the 100% completion checklist.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the game and the second gold. After the story, the 100% checklist opens under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. The good news: it is lenient, closer to 60% true completion — you need 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied. Only robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests demand everything. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable, so it can all be finished in free roam after the credits.

roadmap.note: The big cleanup: about 100 hours after the story.

steps: Finish the story; the checklist appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion.
Work through the checklist: any 100 optional missions, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 200 vehicles scanned, 100 animals studied.
Finish the all-or-nothing rows: all robberies, all shooting range golds, all drone races, all of Bret's target decks, all underwater discoveries.
When every row is ticked, the gold trophy pops.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Mix them freely and pick the easiest; flying under bridges is the quickest to grind. Track progress under Progress, Activities, Stunts, or on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this trophy.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do one of each of the 9 activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt. Check your progress under Touchpad, Progress, Activities — each type shows how many you have done. Most of these come naturally from the story and the other trophies, so this usually pops on its own.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 12 shooting ranges holding 42 challenges between them, and you need a gold medal in every one. The gold thresholds are not brutal, and the 100% checklist needs all of them too, so this is required work, not optional. Practise the weapon types you are weakest at, and remember that shooting ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. You can meditate with both Jason and Lucia at each spot, which counts as +2 at the same location, and you can track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. THE WARNING: this is the one possibly missable trophy in the game. During Chapter 1, one morning after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia says she is going to meditate and walks out to the balcony at Jason's house. Talk to her in the kitchen, follow her and choose Accept. That meditation disappears after Chapter 1, and it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it — the guide authors who earned the trophy had done it. Do it, and keep a manual save from the start of each chapter just in case.

trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting strand is Jason-only and starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. After meeting him he marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he requests and bring them back to him. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker. Which exact animal triggers the trophy is still unconfirmed, but clearing all 15 of Bret's target decks — which the 100% checklist needs anyway — should cover it.

There are well over 100 scannable spots, so it doesn't matter which ones you pick — scan everything interesting as you travel and the trophy comes naturally. WAiNK scanning is also how you discover vehicles for Whip It Good, so the two trophies pair nicely.

Most of them complete naturally while you work on other trophies and the 100% checklist, which needs 70 of 80 — so this trophy comes on the way. If you are short at the end, pick the easiest remaining challenges rather than the hardest ones.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: The earliest you can do this is after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can roam with both characters together — call your partner by holding right and pressing triangle. Get a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone. A fast sports motorcycle through traffic works well, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a favourite escape route: cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter can't see you. The trophy pops once you drive out of the red heat zone. It also comes automatically during the big bank vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Only possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, once you can switch between both characters. With your partner along, rob 3 robbery targets (green icons) in a row while staying wanted the whole time — keep the red and blue flashing wanted level, don't let it drop. Wear an armored vest, carry sticky bombs and healing items. The trophy pops about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop; if it doesn't, hit a fourth shop and keep going. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, available after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app — hold up to open it, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan. You don't need to drive them; scanning is enough. The easiest method is standing on a busy road and scanning everything that passes. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this trophy arrives automatically on the way there. Check your totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus activates with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar. You must down 5 enemies in one activation, which lasts only a few seconds. Prepare first: eat or drink to buff focus, carry Adrenaline to extend it, wear body armor, and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. Line up 5 gang members at a gang operation and take them down fast without missing. Note that soldiers, police and civilians don't seem to count — use gang members. Focus has 4 levels and rises as you play shooting ranges, golf, pool, fish and land headshots, so this gets easier late in the game.

Find 5 gang members at a gang operation, activate Combat Focus (L3 + R3) and down all 5 before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger jet docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — it has to be one connected to a boarding bridge, not a plane sitting on the airfield. The easiest is the one at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get inside, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway, take off and fly about 1 km away from the airport. The trophy pops a little late, once you are far enough out.

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. They stand at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate — or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance — climb into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. That unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and marks jewelry store robberies on the map. Break in through a back door using the Snap Gun instead of kicking it (kicking triggers the alarm), find the note with the safe code inside, and loot the safe. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot for it.

steps: Complete Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to get the Snap Gun.
Enter a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun, not by kicking.
Find the safe code note inside and loot the safe without being detected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, which introduces bank vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open and grab the cash with your partner's help. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 for tips that mark security vans, then follow them to banks. There are 8 large bank jobs in total; the trophy needs any 5, but the 100% checklist needs all 8. Each robbery instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each, making them the best late-game money maker.

roadmap.note: 5 of 8 bank vaults; 100% needs all 8.

steps: Complete the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is.
Buy security van tips from Yasmani ($10,000) to find more banks.
Rob 5 bank vaults and escape the police each time.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: The easiest way is automatic: the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is has you tail an armored truck to a bank, and robbing that vault counts as robbing an armored truck. For an earlier method, find an armored truck driving near banks in Vice City, block its path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. Either way, the trophy only pops after you escape the red heat radius, so get clear of the police first.

Or: find an armored truck near a bank, block it and sticky-bomb its back door.
Escape the red heat radius; the trophy pops once you are clear.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map. Every area you haven't visited sits under black fog, so the fastest method is to take a plane and fly over all the fogged areas until the entire map is visible. You'll clear most of it naturally while travelling for other trophies, then finish the last patches by air.

sources.label: Planet GTA 6 trophy list (Exophase + PSNProfiles cross-check)

roadmap.note: Unfog the whole map; a plane is fastest.

steps: Get a plane and fly over every fogged area of the map.
Check the map for any remaining black patches.
Once the whole map is visible, the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs running 39 illegal operations between them. For this trophy you only need to rob one operation from each gang, but the 100% checklist needs all 39, so you'll finish this on the way. Operations show as yellow icons on the map when you get near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang's count under Progress, Gangs.

roadmap.note: 1 operation per gang (9); 100% needs all 39.

steps: Find illegal operations (yellow map icons) near you.
Rob at least one operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs.
Check Progress, Gangs to see which gangs you still need.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail somewhere with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed by the guide writers as of launch week — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, and other guides agree the method isn't pinned down yet. The sensible approach: visit the bars and beachfront spots along Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view; check back for an update once the community confirms the spot.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window. Two requirements: you need the Key Cloner, unlocked in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, and it has to be that specific blue Banshee — no other car works. It's a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. The trophy pops a little late, after you've driven further down the street.

roadmap.note: Needs the Key Cloner from Chapter 3; the blue Banshee only.

Go to the vehicle showroom in south Vice City.
Hack the blue Banshee with the Key Cloner and drive it straight through the window.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. You'll visit during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Inside, grab the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and blow open the safe in the north-east hallway with sticky bombs (buy them at Ammu-Nation first). The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item. If you miss one, the robbery icon respawns later — you don't need all three in one visit, so it's not missable.

roadmap.note: Kingpin Bowling, Port Gellhorn; 3 valuables, not missable.

During Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2, take the luxury watch, the Gutterball shotgun and the safe contents.
Escape the police; the trophy pops after you get clear.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Work out at fitness clubs — buy a membership, and always bring your partner along (hold right and press triangle to call them), because while one character actively trains, the other completes their training automatically, doubling your progress. Check strength under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, then the Strength stat. You can also work out at home after the story.

roadmap.note: Max strength on both characters; train together for double progress.

steps: Complete Coffee Break in Chapter 2 so you can switch characters.
Buy a fitness club membership and work out with both characters together.
Keep training until both Jason and Lucia are at maximum strength.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on criminal profile notifications in Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, so you see a small demon face on screen whenever an action counts. Stealthy robberies and clean escapes push you toward Professional; incapacitating enemies is Hardened; killing is Violent; mass killing is Psycho; and excessive violence can make you permanently Irredeemable, which makes police more aggressive — avoid that one. You'll almost certainly hit 500 naturally while doing robberies and the 100% checklist. If you're short at the end, running over civilians and cops in a car farms it fast.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The method for this trophy is still unconfirmed by the guide writers at launch — PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. The name suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something, so the working theory is a second try at a Payday Loans robbery. Treat this as unconfirmed: try the Payday Loans angle, and check back once the community pins it down.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go alone, at night after 2 AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. The spawn is slightly random: sometimes a blinking car sits at the roadside — if it's not there, drive away and come back. When the car is there, follow the path into the woods and you'll see the UFO, a bright blue light in the sky. Approach it and it drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, then go back to her car at the roadside and the trophy unlocks.

Look for the blinking car at the roadside; if it's absent, drive away and return.
Follow the path into the woods to the UFO, approach it, talk to the abducted woman and walk her back to her car.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The method is still unconfirmed at launch — PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be kicking enemies while riding a motorcycle. The in-game hint points to a melee drive-by, so the practical approach is to ride a motorcycle past enemies and kick them as you pass. Try it on lone pedestrians or gang members until it pops.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through fences. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check to meet Raul's crew and unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, which lets you launder the bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans stores, and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total counts across all robberies, so you don't need $250,000 at once. Bank vaults give up to $205,000 in a single robbery, so this comes naturally while doing the vaults for Maximum Withdrawal.

roadmap.note: Needs the Dye Pack Jammer from Credit Check, Chapter 3.

Rob banks and Payday Loans stores for marked bills.
Deliver $250,000 total in marked bills to a fence (Yasmani pays best).

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shop types. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way there because they are the most expensive purchases. It counts cumulatively across everything you buy during the game, so by the time you've geared up, modded cars and kitted out both characters, you'll be most of the way there. If you're short, buy a few high-end guns or a full car mod set.

Keep spending across shops until the $100,000 total is reached.
Top up with a high-end gun or full car mod if you're short.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages, which cost $160,000 in total. They become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone — buy them through the app. There are also 4 story-related garages, but those don't count toward this trophy. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4, are the quickest way to raise the cash.

Raise $160,000 through robberies and other jobs.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the phone app.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, which is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses. The app lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. You need garage space first, so buy garages (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray and Register in his garage. Early on he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep expenses down.
